title: TAPP Composition Module: MCICPMS
description:
The shared MCICPMS block of the 2026-08-11 TAPP library (Claude Skills for TAPP/Module_MCICPMS.csv), composed by 3 of the sixteen delivery tables. 15 owned fields over 3 schema paths.

GENERATED by tools/build_module_bb.py from the module's CSV and its schema-path sidecar — edit those, not this file. Requiredness follows the TAPP tier matrix: a field Basic on a side is required there, Advanced is permitted, N/A is absent from that side entirely.

This is a PROFILE, not a vocabulary: it asserts which properties a conforming procedure or analysis carries. Column F (Example / Allowed Content) is consumer-owned per the module manifest, so no enum is pinned here — a consuming TAPP may narrow a value space, never widen it.

ProcedureIdentification.title: MCICPMS on the procedure
ProcedureIdentification.description: Composed into a TAPP (prov:Plan) schema: what the procedure asserts once, for every analysis that follows it.

schema:description.description: Assignment of isotope masses to Faraday cup or ion counter detector positions for this procedure, and the analyte each position serves. Lists the mass number monitored in each collector position with its analyte element where it has one — e.g. 'L3=116Sn (Sn); L2=117Sn (Sn); Ax=120Sn (Sn); H1=121Sb (interference monitor, no analyte)'. Interference-monitor and internal-standard positions serve no analyte and carry no parent element; the analyte list itself is given by the Analyte field and is never inferred from the mass labels here. For static multi-collection procedures, one configuration applies throughout the measurement. For multi-dynamic procedures, list all configurations and the cycling sequence. Different element systems require different mass assignments within the collector array span.

ada:internalNormalizationElementAndIsoto.description: Element and isotope ratio used as the internal normalization standard for mass bias correction. The measured ratio of the normalizing element is used to calculate the mass bias factor β using the chosen mass fractionation law, which is then applied to correct the analyte isotope ratios assuming β_norm ≈ β_analyte. Specify the element, the monitored isotope ratio (e.g., 113Cd/111Cd for Sb measurements), and the certified or consensus value used for correction. Record 'N/A' if internal normalization is not used. Record 'N/A' where the procedure does not use internal normalization.

AnalysisIdentification.title: MCICPMS on the analysis
AnalysisIdentification.description: Composed into a technique detail (schema:Dataset) schema: what each run supplies fresh, because it cannot be known until the analysis happens.

dqv:value.description: Peak flatness actually achieved in the session, assessed against the criterion registered by the procedure. Companion measured value to Peak Flatness Method and Threshold, following the criterion-versus-measurement split used for Oxide Production.
